description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: King
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Point-Blank Shot (0~2), removed after using Apex Point-Blank Shot two times

description.name: Apex Point-Blank Shot Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Point-Blank Shot level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: King]

description.name: Apex Point-Blank Shot Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Point-Blank Shot level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: King]
